greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto, idinkoo maanta isugu yimid si aan u raacno Hooyada Quduuska ah ee murugada leh, iyadoo aan ku duceysanayno xusuusta Benjamin Vo.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Maanta, markaan eegayno Hooyada Quduuska ah ee taagan salka Saliibka, waxaan arkaynaa sawir qoto dheer oo murugo iyo jacayl isku dhex jira. Bal qiyaas, saaxiibbadaa, hooyo taagan meel aanay marnaba rabin inay joogto. Maryan, Hooyada Ciise, waxay aragtaa wiilkeeda, midka ay xambaartay, midka ay korisay, midka ay qalbigeeda ku xirtay, oo ku dhimanaya xanuun weyn. Waxay ahayd seef qalbigeeda ka mudday, sidii uu Simecoon hore ugu sii sheegay. Laakiin xusuuso, xitaa xanuunkaas dhexdiisa, Maryan way taagnayd. Ma aysan cararin. Way joogtay. Taasi waa xoogga hooyonimada. Taasi waa xoogga jacaylka oo aan weligii go'in.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo jeclaado si daacad ah. Waxaan xusuustaa sheekada ku saabsan sida uu u rabay inuu u bixiyo lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi u furan dadka kale, qalbi u furan inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Sida Maryan oo kale, Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay in noloshu aysan ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad bixiso.

Alan iyo Thao, saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idiin sheego si cad oo naxariis leh: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Xanuunka iyo dhimashada ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Waxaad Ben siiseen nolosha ugu quruxda badan ee waalid uu wiil siin karo. Jacaylkaaga, Alan, iyo taageeradaada, Thao, waxay ahaayeen nuurkii uu Ben ku koray. Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Waxaad ahaydeen waalidkii ugu fiicnaa.

Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa akhriska koowaad inaan nahay 'hal jir'. 'Sida jidhku u yahay mid, inkastoo uu leeyahay qaybo badan... saasoo kale Masiixu.' Markaad dareemaysaan murugada, ogow inaad ku jirtaan jidhka Masiixa. Ben ma aha mid fog; wuxuu ku jiraa wadaagga quduusiinta. Sida Maryan oo kale, oo qaybsatay xanuunka wiilkeeda, Ilaah wuxuu qaybsadaa xanuunkaaga. Ma nihin kuwo keligood ah. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay adiga kugu adkaayeen. Waxaad weyday walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, iyo kii aad la wadaagi jirtay qolka iyo riyooyinka. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu yahay mid ku eegaya dhoolacaddayn. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo xiriirka idinka dhexeeya ma go'in; wuxuu ku jiraa xiriirka quduuska ah ee salaadda. Sii wad inaad riyooto, sii wad inaad noolaato, waayo Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad faraxsan tahay. 

Ceelka biyaha ee 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' ee Cà Mau waa calaamad muujinaysa in naxariistii Ben ay weli u qulqulayso sidii biyo nadiif ah oo kale, iyadoo quudinaysa dadka oomman. Magaciisa 'Đại Dương' oo macnaheedu yahay Badweyn Weyn wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in naxariista Ilaah ay ka ballaaran tahay murugo kasta. 

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada kaliya markaad dhex joogto xanuunka. U dhiib shabaggaaga gacmaha Rabbiga. U ogolow Ciise inuu kula socdo. Benjamin, wiilkaygii qaaliga ahaa, noo ducee. Noo ducee annaga oo halkan joogna, si aan u helno xoog aan ku sii soconno, illaa aan mar kale kulanno oo aan aragno dhoolacaddayntaada quruxda badan albaabka Jannada. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax kasta, waxaanan ku raadinayaa naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan u imow naftayda si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo hore u joogay, waxaanan naftayda u dhiibayaa adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa, halkaas oo aanay jirin xanuun iyo murugo.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska qaada, inuu Rabbigu siiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo aan dhammaad lahayn.

readings.label: Akhriska 1aad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow: Sida jidhku u yahay mid, inkastoo uu leeyahay qaybo badan, oo qaybaha jidhku, inkastoo ay badan yihiin, ay yihiin jidh keliya, saasoo kale Masiixu. Waayo, Ruux keliya ayaannu dhammaanteen ku baabtiisannay jidh keliya, ha ahaadeen Yuhuud ama Gariig, addoon ama qof xor ah, oo dhammaanteen waxaa naloo waraabiyey Ruux keliya. Hadda jidhku ma aha qayb keliya, laakiin waa qaybo badan. Hadda waxaad tihiin jidhka Masiixa, oo mid kastaaba qayb ka mid ah ayuu yahay. Ilaah wuxuu kaniisadda u magacaabay, marka hore, rasuullada; marka labaad, nebiyada; marka saddexaad, macallimiinta; markaas ka dib, shuqullada xoogga leh; markaas ka dib, hadiyadaha bogsashada, caawinta, maamulka, iyo noocyada afafka. Dhammaan ma rasuullo baa? Dhammaan ma nebiyo baa? Dhammaan ma macallimiin baa? Dhammaan ma shuqullo xoog leh bay sameeyaan? Dhammaan ma haystaan hadiyadaha bogsashada? Dhammaan ma afaf bay ku hadlaan? Dhammaan ma fasiraan? Si aad ah u raadso hadiyadaha ruuxiga ah ee ugu waaweyn.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waxaan nahay dadkiisa: idaha raacitaankiisa. Rabbiga si farxad leh ugu gabya, dhammaantiin dhulka; Rabbiga ugu adeega farxad; hortiisa kaalay heeso farxad leh. R. Waxaan nahay dadkiisa: idaha raacitaankiisa. Ogaada in Rabbigu yahay Ilaah; isagaa na abuuray, annaguna isaga ayaannu nahay; dadkiisa, idaha uu daaqiyo. R. Waxaan nahay dadkiisa: idaha raacitaankiisa. Guryihiisa ku gala mahadnaq, barxadihiisa ku gala ammaan; isaga u mahadnaqa; magiciisa barakeeya. R. Waxaan nahay dadkiisa: idaha raacitaankiisa. Waayo, Rabbigu waa wanaagsan yahay, naxariistiisu weligeed bay sii jirtaa, daacadnimadiisuna waa tan jiilalka oo dhan. R. Waxaan nahay dadkiisa: idaha raacitaankiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Salka Saliibka Ciise waxaa taagnaa hooyadiis, iyo walaashii hooyadiis, Maryanaydii naagtii Kloopas, iyo Maryanaydii reer Magdala. Markuu Ciise arkay hooyadiis iyo xertii uu jeclaa oo halkaas taagan, wuxuu hooyadiis ku yidhi, 'Naag yahay, eeg wiilkaaga.' Markaasuu xertii ku yidhi, 'Eeg hooyadaa.' Oo saacaddaas laga bilaabo xertii waxay hooyadiis u kaxaysatay gurigeeda.

day: Memorial of Our Lady of Sorrows

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.
